magellanic.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to, or named from, Magellan, the
   navigator.
magellanic.translation: a. (葡萄牙航海家)麦哲伦的,以麦哲伦命名的, 麦哲伦海峡的

magellanic cloud.translation: [网络] 麦哲伦云；麦哲伦星云；杜鹃座

s. of deep purplish red

n. 品红色, 洋红
